title: Prediction of student learning style using modified decision tree algorithm in E-learning system
reason: Decision-tree classification of FSLSM dimensions from Moodle web logs. 'Actual' styles have no stated independent measurement (no ILS questionnaire), so reported accuracy reflects agreement with log-based rules, not an empirical relation to a measured learning style.

extraction.country: nr (authors: Karpagam University, India; Muscat College, Oman; data institution not named)
extraction.design: classifier development (modified decision tree vs J48 etc., 10-fold CV)
extraction.n_quote: log files of approximately around 300 datasets of learners
extraction.population: students in 5 online computing courses over 3 semesters, 1 institution
extraction.lms_indicators: Moodle web-log actions: forum views/posts, assignment and exam actions, content type views
extraction.outcome_or_construct: FSLSM perception, input and processing dimensions (label source not described)
extraction.notes: Reports overall accuracy 87% (abstract) and average 91% (results), internally inconsistent. Perception confusion matrix: 150 of 210 'Neutral'. Secondary code: E1 (source of the 'actual' learning-style labels is not given).
